outcome: newborn requiring Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) admission
cohort: 199 mothers of newborns hospitalized in NICU, and a control group of 127 mothers of healthy newborns
finding: Disordered eating attitudes in gestation may significantly influence the pregnancy outcomes and newborns' health.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more frequent in the group with disordered eating attitudes.
